notes: I replaced the two piecewise quadratics in the valley with cubics fit to the dense E12 data: the right side of the dip is steeper than a quadratic (cubic through (-1.05,6.42),(-0.8,18.22),(-0.6,39.20),(0,106.05)), and the left side needed a cubic in u=x+1.05 to match the steeper approach near the minimum. E8/E10 confirmed the outer branches are exactly linear, so those rules stay.
